content: Anmar we-ibmar sogsale, ¿anmar na dukin gannar san-ogannonai be anmar-dake? Ar igi-baigan na e-daed-barsognaid-garda sesdamala, ¿deyob an bese sedabi be an-abemarsunde? ¿Be-garda deyob baiganse seedbi be an-abemarsunde?
Ar bemar anmar-gardayob gumalad, bemar anmar-gwagegi narmakar-naid. Bela mag be-dakmalad, degine, bela-dulemar absogedbimarbalid.

Ar bemar Cristo-garda-narmaksad gumalad. Anmar we-garda-uksamalad gumalad. We-garda-narmaklesadi, ibmar-nisgi narmaklearsulid. Narmakaledi, Bab-Dummad-Dula-Maid E-Burbagi narmakaled. Akwagi epenne igi-narmaklesa, deyobi, narmaklearsurbalid. Narmakaledi, dulemar-gwage-dula-naidgi narmakaled.
Ar anmar we-ibmar Bab-Dummadgi Cristoʼba bensulid, we-an-bemarga-sogedi napiragwad.
Anmar bela sunna ibmar dukin imakmardeeye an sogsurdo. Suli, degisuli. Anmar sunna Bab-Dummad-e-gangued-ukmaidba bela ibmar imaked.

Degine, Bab-Dummad na e, igar-binid-megisad-e-maiga-guega anmar-imaksad. Igar-narmakar-maidbarsulid. Burbaledba narmakaled. Ar epenne garda-sanar-narmaklesaddi, sunna dule-oburgwed. Ar igar-biniddi, burbaledid, adi, dule-odulogedid.
Ar we-igar-gebedi dule-oburgwe-inigwele, akwagi-narmakar-uklesgu, gandikidba-gae uklesad. Degisoggu, Israel-dulemar Moisés-e-wagar-gandikidba-dakarmaked-berguoed-inigwele, geg-dake gusmalad.
Degisoggu, Bab-Burba-e-arbaed-bursunna, bur bule yeerdakle gued.
Ar we-igar-dule-sabsur-odurdaked yeerdaklegedga gusadde, ar dule-isgussulidyob-imaked-igar-bursunna, bur bule yeerdakle gudo.
We-igar-idualed-yeerdaklegedga-gusadi, igar-burbaled bur nue-yeerdakle-danikoed-ebo be dakdele, danikoedi, bur bule nue-yeerdakle danikoed.
Ar igar-sunna-bergued nue-yeerdaklegedga nabir gusadde, ar ibmar-degisadeguoed-bursunna, bur bule nue-yeerdaklegedga guodo.
Degisoggu, anmar bensulidgi deyob edarbedisoggu, innikigwadba anmar dobsuli ibmar sogdisunnad.
Anmardi, Moisésʼyobi imaksurmalad. Anmardi, sanakwaa ibmar sogdiid. Moisésʼdina, e-wagar-idu dunwed nasikdaed, adi, melle Israel-dulemar e-wagar-dakarmaknaid-bergumaid dakegar.
Ar Israel-dulemar we-ibmar aku-itogusmalad. Amba emidsega, Moisés-Igar-Maid-absodmalale, dunwe-e-idu-nasiklesadyobi e-idu naid. Ar Cristoʼbi a-dunwed unnila osuloged.
Amba emi-ibase, Israel-dulemar Moisés-Igar-Maid-absodmalale, amba e-gwagegi aku-itomalad.
Ar dule Bab-Jesúsʼba-naigunonikile, we-dunweyob-naidaedi, ega surgunonidaed.
Ar Bab-Jesúsʼde, Bab-Burba gued. Degisoggu, bia Bab-Jesús-Burba gudii, agine, ollorguleged-amileged.

Degisoggu, bela anmar-wagar-idu ibmar bar naisursoggu, anmar ispeyobi gusunnad. Bab-Jesús-e-gandik-gaed anmar oyonaisunnad. Degisoggu, anmar bur bule Bab-Jesús-e-yeerdakleged nikumaisoggu, Cristoʼyobi dakledanigussunnad. Weyobi, Bab-Jesús ibmar imaked. Ar Bab-Jesúsʼde, Bab-Burba gued.
